open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: `invariant_ledger.json` is the evidence of 2026-07-19 whose rows were distributed into the decisions (Status above). It keeps wording the owner withdrew with the email challenges
open_points.question: Which text is authoritative when a decision and a retained ledger row differ, and where are the current formal invariants identified now that the overview no longer says the decisions' Formal invariants are current?
options: The decisions are authoritative and the ledger is historical evidence only
The ledger rows remain authoritative unless an individual status says otherwise
Both must be reconciled and any conflict blocks implementation
open_points.default_guess: Treat the decisions and R0-23 as authoritative and use the ledger only as historical evidence.

witness.initial: A staff account exists in a product whose current rules remove all email challenges.
events: A later agent derives implementation and tests from the decisions.
Another later agent derives them from the retained ledger wording for INV-003 and INV-004.
outcomes: No challenge-token model, operation, or invariant test is created.
Challenge-token state and invariant tests are created.
witness.observer: Developers, test runners, and API consumers

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: whose rows were distributed into the decisions ... It keeps wording the owner withdrew ... and INV-010…INV-013 and INV-016
open_points.question: Does “whose rows were distributed into the decisions” include the withdrawn and removed rows, or were only surviving rows distributed?
options: Every ledger row was distributed, including obsolete rows retained only with a removed status
Only current rows were distributed; withdrawn and removed rows were excluded
Obsolete rows were distributed and remain undecided until their individual decisions resolve them
open_points.default_guess: Read “distributed” as applying only to surviving current requirements, with obsolete rows retained solely as historical evidence.

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.question: What status applies to each retained ledger row, especially INV-001, INV-003, INV-004, INV-010…INV-014 and INV-016, and what implementation or test consequence does each status have?
options: Withdrawn or removed rows impose no implementation or Required tests obligation
Withdrawn wording is inactive but replacement invariants still require tests
All retained rows remain test obligations until an explicit per-row status says otherwise
open_points.default_guess: Give removed challenge-related requirements no implementation or test obligation, while preserving and testing any replacement invariant stated in the decisions.

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: the verified email of INV-001 and INV-014
open_points.question: Does “verified email” mean the removed email-verification requirement, the still-required recorded “email verified” mark from R0-23, or both?
options: Only email-verification behavior was withdrawn; the recorded mark remains required
Both verification behavior and the recorded mark were withdrawn
INV-001 and INV-014 each contain mixed wording that must be split into withdrawn and surviving parts
open_points.default_guess: Preserve the inert recorded mark required by R0-23, but remove every verification workflow, authorization effect, and email challenge.

witness.initial: An administrator activates a staff account.
outcomes: The operation records the inert email-verified mark and the view shows it, as R0-23 requires.
The operation omits the mark because the overview says the verified-email wording was withdrawn.

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: INV-001…INV-015 | IAM: sessions, capabilities, secrets (INV-010…INV-013 and INV-016, the email challenges, removed 2026-11-07, R0-23)
open_points.question: Is INV-016 part of the IAM range and ownership entry despite lying outside INV-001…INV-015, or is it intentionally outside every listed ID range?
options: INV-016 belongs to the IAM ownership entry but is mentioned only as removed history
INV-016 is outside the table because removal means it has no owner or landing
The range should be INV-001…INV-016, with removed IDs separately marked
open_points.default_guess: Treat INV-016 as removed historical IAM material with no current owner, landing, implementation, or Required tests obligation.

open_points.subject: 02_rules.md:Invariant ledger overview
open_points.text: Every invariant names exactly one owning responsibility
open_points.question: Does “every invariant” include the withdrawn and removed invariants that the evidence still retains, and if so what single owning responsibility does INV-016 have?
options: It means every current formal invariant only
It includes historical withdrawn and removed ledger rows
Removed rows must retain a historical owner but have no current implementation owner
open_points.default_guess: Apply the rule only to current formal invariants; record historical ownership separately if needed.
